summary: Tested Phase 1 (payroll fixes) and Phase 2 (data/UX cleanup). Backend: 9/9 unit tests in test_attendance_calc.py pass. New integration suite test_iter15_payroll_fixes.py: 18/18 pass. It covers auto-close (no shift 17:12 to 23:59 = 407m; day shift closes at 18:00 = 48m; night shift closes at 23:59 the same day; reason 'missed checkout'), the reports auto_closed_sessions count, running minutes in stats (>=120), absent rules (Sundays, holidays, approved leave, no-shift, pending invite, created_at and profile date_of_joining, future days), branch/department/employee filters, CSV columns, weekly_off validation, activity filters/pagination/403 for sub-admin, removal archiving to removed_users with attendance kept, and ESI number clearing N/A. Frontend: Overview legend and linear lines, y-axis from 0. Deep links: hash updates, #leave opens the Leave tab, back goes to the previous tab. Activity tab: plain sentences, full width, search/action/person/date filters, prev/next. Team: weekly-off picker saves [5,6]; MORE menu opens the remove dialog; confirm stays disabled until the name is typed; removal archives the user. 24/7 tooltip present. Branches banner text and unpinned-warning are correct. My Day lists the allowed branches (GeoTest HQ). Profile shows the ESI optional label and N/A flow. Nudge is hidden at 100% (bank approved, no ESI). Header avatar uses the profile avatar. No blocking bugs; only minor issues below.

minor.issue: late_today counts attendance records, not distinct people: one person who checks in late twice is counted 2. It also does not check has_shift, unlike build_report. The analytics chart's late count also ignores has_shift.

If one payload has both esi='1234567890' and esi_not_applicable=true, the N/A branch runs last and wipes the ESI. The UI never sends this (the input is disabled while N/A is ticked), but the order is fragile. The esi value should win.
from/to filter compares the date string with created_at stored in UTC. Events between 00:00 and 05:30 IST land on the previous day.
holiday_days = len(all holidays in range), even for days before joining or for pending invites. today_d uses DEFAULT_TZ, not the user's timezone.
When a late (next-day) checkout is capped, auto_close_reason is not set; only the background close_session sets it. Records are inconsistent for reports/UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening /admin with no hash calls pushState('#overview'), which adds an extra history entry. One Back from a fresh /admin stays on /admin; it takes 2 backs to leave. Use replaceState for the first sync.

Underscores are replaced inside free text, so the email 'test_remove_ui15@example.com' shows as 'test remove ui15@example.com'. 'weekly_off=[5, 6]' is split on the comma and shows 'weekly off set to [5 · 6]' (should be 'Sat, Sun').
Some option labels left after stripping {t} read badly: 'Approved bank details for', 'Changed field-staff access for', 'Updated which teams manages', 'Set a password for'.
The name check ignores case ('test_remove ui' would pass). The spec asks for the exact name. The MORE menu (details element) stays open after the dialog closes or is cancelled.

issues: With all-zero data, domain [0,'dataMax'] gives one '0' tick and a flat line in the middle. Use a minimum max (e.g. Math.max(dataMax, 4)).

design_issues.screen: Activity / Profile / Overview attendance log / Team edit modal
issues: Native browser date/time pickers (mm/dd/yyyy, --:--) instead of the shadcn calendar/time components

action_items: Optional: use history.replaceState on the first hash sync in AdminPanel to avoid the double-back
Optional: in humanDetails, keep values like emails unchanged and show weekly_off as day names
Optional: make admin_stats late_today count distinct users who have a shift
Optional: make clean_profile let a non-empty esi win over esi_not_applicable=true; set auto_close_reason in check_out when capped
Optional: make the remove-dialog name match case-sensitive, and close the MORE menu after the action
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3080 lines; split it into routers (attendance, admin, reports, profile).
auto_close_stale_sessions runs on every /admin/stats and build_report call and loads all open records. That is fine at this size, but the background loop already exists.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows work; minor cosmetic issues)

seed_data_creation: Throwaway TEST_Emp15_* users, rec_test15_* attendance, lv_test15_* leave, TEST_Hol15 holiday and TEST_Remove UI (UI removal) were all created and then deleted by id. Users removed during tests produced 'employee_removed'/'employee_added' activity log entries (left as audit trail). No seed/real data was modified.
